name: Ahmed Mohamed Noaman
title: Flutter Developer & Mobile Application Engineer | DevOps & Release Engineering
summary: Flutter developer and Computer Engineering student who has taken a product from an empty repository to a published app: Strong 8K, a cross-platform IPTV streaming client for Android, Android TV and Windows, delivered end to end as a freelance engagement. Comfortable across the whole delivery path - Flutter and native Kotlin playback code, a Node.js service with nginx and systemd on Linux, white-label build tooling, CI, and app-store submission - and recently completed a DevOps engineering course covering Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Prometheus and Grafana on AWS and Azure. Completed AMIT Learning's Flutter Diploma with a 95% grade.

experience.description: Freelance engagement as sole developer of a white-label IPTV/OTT player for Android phones, tablets and D-pad TV boxes and for Windows desktop: live TV, movies, series, radio, EPG, time-shift, catch-up, downloads, device activation and parental controls. Published on the Microsoft Store; Android 1.0.9 release-ready for Google Play.
experience.stack: Flutter, Dart, Provider, Kotlin (Media3/ExoPlayer platform view), libmpv via media_kit, Node.js, Express, React (react-admin), nginx, systemd, Let's Encrypt, Codemagic CI, MSIX
bullets: Built the Flutter client - 173 Dart files, 51 screens, three locales with full RTL Arabic - with one UI over two playback engines (Media3/ExoPlayer on Android, libmpv on Windows).

Designed server failover that distinguishes a blocked host from an expired subscription, authenticating candidate hosts concurrently and keeping the operator's priority order instead of the fastest responder.
Fixed frozen-video-with-live-audio stalls by plumbing decoder frame counters from Kotlin across the platform channel into a pure-function playback watchdog.
Moved a ~27 MB offline catalogue and ~118k-entry guide into isolate workers with delta sync, single-flight writes and crash-safe rename-on-complete, so weak TV boxes stay responsive.

Wrote and deployed the reviewer demo service (Node.js/Express, 2,600 LOC, two dependencies, timing-safe auth) on Ubuntu behind nginx and TLS, with a 2,375-line idempotent installer and a 780-line post-deploy smoke test.

Built a 1,800-line white-label build driver that turns one codebase into 15 brand configurations, restores every touched file on failure, and a Codemagic pipeline that runs analysis and 2,600+ tests and verifies the produced binary is a genuine release build.

Grew the test suite with the code: 131 test files, 2,603 passing tests at the final commit; led both Microsoft Store (MSIX) and Google Play submission paperwork, data-safety and TV-banner requirements.
